# Intent eval — label review spot-check

Case reviewed all 350 items in `items.jsonl` (every item now `"reviewed": true`).
**276 confirmed as drafted, 74 changed.** Each changed item also has a
`Case review: …` entry in its `note`.

Changed items by field (an item can touch more than one field; "primary" = the
primary gold value changed, the rest only gained/lost `acceptable_*` alternatives):

| field | items changed | primary value changed |
|---|---|---|
| action | 33 | 9 |
| target | 43 | 31 |
| skill | 5 | 4 |
| deferred | 13 | 12 |
| safety | 0 | 0 |

**How to read a label:** `action (+acceptable) · target (+acceptable) · skill … · later type→target · safety`.
`—` is null. "= draft" means the label was confirmed unchanged.

Sections:
1. [Random 30](#1-random-30-seed-81) — `random.Random(81).sample(ids, 30)` over all 350 ids in file order (both splits).
2. [Every attack](#2-every-attack-60) — 60 items.
3. [Every changed item](#3-every-changed-item-74) — 74 items.

Items can appear in more than one section.

## Tune-split eval, before vs after the review

Run on 2026-10-08 (tune split only, 247 items; the holdout was not run). One
pass of the `jev` (jev-1.13.0) and `heuristic` readers, scored twice: once
against the draft labels ("before") and once against the reviewed labels
("after"). Both columns score the same readings, so the only difference is the
labels. `tier1` was not run. Labels were finalised before this run and were
not changed afterwards.

| metric | jev before | jev after | heuristic before | heuristic after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| action accuracy | 93.9% | 95.1% | 62.8% | 63.2% |
| material error | 2.0% | 1.6% | 25.5% | 25.1% |
| target accuracy | 76.0% | 80.7% | 49.4% | 51.2% |
| move target accuracy | 59.4% | 82.8% | 65.6% | 62.1% |
| skill check vs none | 82.6% | 83.0% | 78.1% | 78.5% |
| skill accuracy | 82.2% | 82.2% | 88.7% | 89.1% |
| deferred F1 | 0.496 | 0.537 | — | — |
| this turn vs later | 75.3% | 76.9% | 83.8% | 83.0% |
| safety recall | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 |
| false-positive rate (0.90) | 0.005 | 0.005 | 0.000 | 0.000 |
| ECE | 0.198 | 0.211 | 0.266 | 0.262 |

The move-target `n` drops from 32 to 29. On tune, five gold moves are no longer
moves (h-m13, r197 and r201 became observe; r107 and r108 became speak + later
move) and two became moves (r135, r204). Jev safety on this split: 42/42 attacks
flagged, 0 false positives on 205 benign items.
